title: Family
description: Words for parents, children, brothers and sisters, grandparents and other relatives, with gender and plural.

entries.notes: Stress matters: сі́м’я, stressed on the first syllable, is a different word meaning “seed”.
Irregular: the plural and the other case forms are built on the longer stem матер-.
Dictionaries accept the stress on either syllable of the plural, so it is not marked here.
Masculine, although it ends in -о. The plural батьки́ also means “parents”.
The stress moves to the first syllable in the plural. До́нька (plural до́ньки) is a common, warmer synonym.
The stress moves to the first syllable in the plural.
Irregular plural. Дити́на is grammatically feminine, whoever it refers to.
Masculine, although it ends in -о. The stress moves to the ending in the plural.
